blog_core_web_vitals_fixes_core_web_vita.question: Do Core Web Vitals affect rankings much?
blog_core_web_vitals_fixes_core_web_vita.answer: They are a tiebreaker rather than a primary signal, but the conversion and crawl-efficiency gains usually justify the work by themselves.

blog_core_web_vitals_fixes_good_lcp.question: What is a good LCP?
blog_core_web_vitals_fixes_good_lcp.answer: Under 2.5 seconds for 75% of real users. Under 2 seconds is a safer target on mobile networks.

blog_core_web_vitals_fixes_why_my_lighth.question: Why is my Lighthouse score good but Search Console says failing?
blog_core_web_vitals_fixes_why_my_lighth.answer: Lighthouse is a lab simulation on your device; Search Console reports real-user field data across devices and networks.

blog_core_web_vitals_fixes_page_builder_.question: Does a page builder ruin Core Web Vitals?
blog_core_web_vitals_fixes_page_builder_.answer: Heavy builders make good scores harder but not impossible — trimming unused modules, scripts and fonts usually recovers most of the gap.

blog_core_web_vitals_fixes_long_until_im.question: How long until improvements show in Search Console?
blog_core_web_vitals_fixes_long_until_im.answer: Field data updates on a 28-day rolling window, so allow roughly a month after deployment for the report to reflect fixes.
